description: This file contains unit tests for the CatalogItem endpoints in the Public API of the eShopOnWeb project, specifically testing the GET by ID functionality.

classes.name: CatalogItemGetByIdEndpointTest
classes.description: A test class for the CatalogItem GET by ID endpoint in the public API, containing tests for successful retrieval and not found responses.

methods.name: ReturnsItemGivenValidId
methods.description: Tests that retrieving a catalog item with a valid ID returns the expected item with status 200.

methods.name: ReturnsNotFoundGivenInvalidId
methods.description: Tests that retrieving a catalog item with an invalid ID returns a 404 Not Found status.
